description: Search and explore the MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) controlled vocabulary. Returns MeSH records of every type — descriptors, supplementary concepts, qualifiers, and pharmacological actions — each with its record type and the PubMed clause that searches it, plus tree numbers, scope notes, entry terms, year introduced, previous indexing, and the exact heading match's allowable subheadings, with pagination via offset for paging past the maxResults cap.

includeDetails.description: Include each record's details: scope note, tree numbers, entry terms, year introduced, previous indexing, and — on the exact heading match only — its allowable subheadings. `recordType` and `searchTerm` are returned either way.

maxResults.description: Maximum results per page, up to 50 per call. A larger value is served at 50, with a notice; continue from `nextOffset`.

offset.description: Result offset for pagination (0-based). Pass the `nextOffset` from the previous response to get the following page; the exact match is pinned to the first page only.

query.description: MeSH term (a heading, supplementary concept, or qualifier name) or free-text term to look up. Must carry a term: a value of only whitespace or invisible characters, such as a zero-width space, is rejected rather than searched.

name: pubmed_lookup_mesh

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `queue_full`: The local NCBI request queue shed the call — the queue is full, or the call cannot start before its total deadline (for example behind the cooldown that follows an NCBI 429). `ncbi_unreachable`: NCBI E-utilities failed on every attempt the retry budget allowed — retries ran out, the next backoff would overrun the total deadline, or the call made one attempt without retrying because the previous call to the same E-utility had failed on every attempt. `ncbi_rate_limited`: NCBI answered HTTP 429 (too many requests) and the call stopped on it — retries ran out, the next backoff would overrun the total deadline, or the Retry-After NCBI named outlasts the time left or the 30-second backoff cap. `ncbi_deadline_exceeded`: The total NCBI request deadline expired before NCBI answered successfully — mid-request, while queued, or during a retry backoff. `ncbi_invalid_response`: NCBI returned a body that could not be parsed (invalid XML/JSON). `ncbi_resource_not_found`: NCBI returned a structured "not found" error for the requested ID(s). `blank_query`: The query contains no search term: nothing is left once whitespace and invisible characters such as a zero-width space are disregarded. pubmed_search_articles and pubmed_europepmc_search first decode HTML entities and also disregard markup and parentheses, so `()`, ``, and ` ` hold no term there; pubmed_search_articles also disregards bracketed field tags such as `[pdat]`. On pubmed_search_articles an exactly-empty `query` is not blank: it means no query, and the search runs on its filters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset to request for the next page. Omitted when this is the last page, so its absence is the end-of-results signal.

notice.description: Optional guidance when no MeSH records matched, the offset overshot the result set, or a `maxResults` past the per-call cap of 50 was served at 50 — suggests spell-check, free-text search, resetting the offset, or the `nextOffset` to continue from. Absent on a result page that needs none of these.

offset.description: Result offset this page was read from

entrezUid.description: NCBI Entrez UID for this record — the join key for E-utilities (eSummary/eFetch db=mesh).

meshId.description: Canonical MeSH unique identifier (e.g. "D003924", "C000626284", "Q000009") — resolves at the MeSH Browser and NLM linked data. A pharmacological-action record carries its descriptor's UI. Omitted only when eSummary returned no record for this UID.

name.description: The record's preferred term: a heading, qualifier, or supplementary concept name as NLM writes it.

previousIndexing.description: Headings that indexed this concept before it was introduced, each with its years (e.g. "Heart Failure, Congestive (1989-2007)"). A date-bounded search reaching back before yearIntroduced also needs them: look each up by name, without its years, and search the `searchTerm` returned. A current heading returns its own record; a retired one, which matches nothing as `[mh]`, returns the heading that holds its records. Omitted when there are none.

recordType.description: MeSH record type as NCBI reports it: "descriptor", "supplemental-record" (a supplementary concept), "pharmacological-action", or "qualifier". A drug-class heading returns two records under one name and meshId, its descriptor and its pharmacological-action record. Omitted when the summary names no type.

searchTerm.description: PubMed clause that searches this record, for the `pubmed_search_articles` query: `"Name"[mh]` for a descriptor, `[pt]` for a publication type (a descriptor in the V tree), `[nm]` for a supplementary concept, which no `[mh]` clause matches, `[pa]` for a pharmacological action, `[sh]` for a qualifier. Omitted when recordType is absent or unrecognized.

subheadings.description: Qualifiers this heading accepts, each combined as `"Heading/qualifier"[mh]`; a qualifier the heading does not accept matches nothing. Present only with includeDetails, on the exact heading match pinned to the first page of a query with no field tag. Its absence on any other record does not mean the heading takes none: look that heading up by name to get its list.

treeNumbers.description: Navigable MeSH tree numbers (e.g. "D02.078.370.141.450"). Omitted for supplementary concept records (SCRs), which map to a heading rather than occupying a tree position, and for pharmacological-action records, whose descriptor carries the tree positions.

yearIntroduced.description: Year the record entered MeSH, as NLM gives it, unparsed: usually a year ("2008", "2008 (1966)", "2017(1967)"), occasionally a history note. Omitted when NLM records none.

totalCount.description: Total MeSH records matching the query upstream, before the maxResults cap

title: Pubmed Lookup Mesh
